topic: User with edit role can't modify a dashboard
symptom_pattern: A user with a role that includes dashboard write permission sees a read-only dashboard and can't save changes, while they can edit other dashboards.
root_cause: That specific dashboard has granular access set so only certain roles/teams can edit it; the user's role isn't on its restriction list.
resolution_path: Compare with the user's roles and teams
Ask the owner or an admin to add the role/team to the editors

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can the user edit other dashboards?
What does the dashboard's permissions panel show?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: 'Restricted: only Platform Team can edit.' I didn't know that existed.
